paper_title: MICROSCOPE mission: first constraints on the violation of the weak equivalence principle by a light scalar dilaton
coupling_convention: dimensionless alpha (Yukawa strength relative to gravity), q=B
notes: MICROSCOPE WEP test constrains a light scalar (dilaton) Yukawa fifth force. Main result: |alpha|<1e-11 for baryon-number coupling (q=B) for scalar masses < 1e-12 eV (Yukawa range > a few 1e5 m); a separate q=B-L result gives |alpha|<1e-12. Values taken from abstract/text (Fig. 1 exclusion region). Emitted as a horizontal (mass-independent below 1e-12 eV) bound. Note alpha here is Yukawa strength relative to gravity, not necessarily the standard d_g convention; downstream may need adjustment. 2-sigma (95% CL).
